quarterly_data.quarter: NVIDIA press release: European Mobility Leaders Build Safe Vehicles and Robotaxi (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NVIDIA (release): Volvo Cars is adopting NVIDIA Hyperion and Alpamayo Stack software for automated driving; Bolt has selected Alpamayo Stack for its European robotaxi program, starting with future Lucid vehicles built on Hyperion, as part of a planned European rollout of at least 25,000 level 4-capable vehicles (real-world data gathering planned in Madrid in 2027, subject to regulatory approval); Mercedes-Benz is extending its partnership on Hyperion and Alpamayo Stack for L3 and L4; Einride is building its next Einride Driver on Hyperion; Aptiv, Valeo and Schaeffler are building Hyperion-based computing platforms for L4 vehicles and robotaxis. NVIDIA also introduced Halos SAFE, Alpamayo 2 Edge (a 2-billion-parameter model for DRIVE AGX Thor) and Alpamayo Agentic Factory (expected early 2027). Bolt, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles and Einride use cases shown at GTC Berlin are demonstrations.
quarterly_data.figure: Bolt planned rollout of at least 25,000 L4-capable vehicles
